recipes.name: Boeuf Bourguignon
recipes.description: Beef braised in red Burgundy with lardons, pearl onions and mushrooms until fork-tender.

steps.instruction: Brown lardons then beef; cook vegetables; deglaze with wine.
Add stock and bouquet garni; braise covered at 150°C ~3 hours.
Glaze onions and mushrooms in butter; add for last 30 minutes.
Thicken with beurre manié to a lacquered sauce.

videos.videoTitle: How to Make Beef Bourguignon | Step-by-Step With Melissa Clark | NYT Cooking

recipes.name: Pot-au-Feu
recipes.description: France's Sunday hearth: beef cuts poached with root vegetables, served as broth-then-platter.

steps.instruction: Cover meats with cold water; bring barely to a simmer and skim religiously.
Poach gently 2.5 hours with aromatics.
Add vegetables in stages by hardness.
Serve broth first with croutons, then meats and vegetables with mustard and cornichons.

videos.videoTitle: How To Make Pot Au Feu: the mother recipe of French soups ( Tutorial for beginners)

recipes.name: Steak Frites
recipes.description: Bistro eternal: seared sirloin under a knob of maître d' butter beside twice-cooked pommes frites.

steps.instruction: Fry potatoes at 150°C until soft; rest; fry again at 190°C until gold.
Sear seasoned steaks hard 2 minutes per side; rest 5.
Top with melting herb butter; serve alongside frites.

recipes.name: Daube Provençale
recipes.description: Provence's wine-braised beef scented with orange peel, herbs de Provence and black olives.

steps.instruction: Marinate beef in wine and aromatics overnight.
Drain, pat dry, brown with pork; return marinade plus stock.
Braise low 3 hours; stir in olives at the end.

videos.videoTitle: EASY FRENCH DAUBE PROVENÇALE (BRAISED BEEF STEW)

recipes.name: Soupe à l'Oignon Gratinée
recipes.description: Caramelized onion soup under a lid of crusty baguette and molten Gruyère.

steps.instruction: Caramelize onions properly - 45-55 minutes, low and patient.
Deglaze with wine; add stock; simmer 15 minutes.
Ladle into bowls; float toast; blanket with cheese.
Gratinée under broiler until blistering.

videos.videoTitle: How To Make French Onion Soup (Onion Soup Gratinée) | Jacques Pépin

recipes.name: Salade de Chèvre Chaud
recipes.description: Warm goat-cheese toasts over bitter greens, walnuts and honey-mustard vinaigrette.

steps.instruction: Toast baguette rounds; top each with a cheese round.
Grill until cheese slumps and browns.
Dress greens; arrange toasts and walnuts; drizzle honey.

videos.videoTitle: LA SALADE DE CHÈVRE CHAUD : MES DEUX VERSIONS ! VOUS PRÉFÉREZ LAQUELLE ?

recipes.name: Bavette Sauce Échalotes
recipes.description: Thin flank steak seared hard and rested under a silky shallot red-wine reduction.

steps.instruction: Season steaks generously with salt and pepper.
Sear in a screaming-hot pan 3 minutes per side; rest 8 minutes.
In the same pan, sweat shallots in butter until golden; deglaze with wine and stock.
Reduce by half; whisk in mustard and cold butter; slice steak and pour sauce over.

recipes.name: Boudin Noir
recipes.description: Classic French blood sausage with caramelised apples and creamy mash.

steps.instruction: Boil potatoes until tender; mash with butter and warm milk.
Prick boudin noir; poach gently in simmering water 12 minutes.
Pan-fry in butter until casing crisps and chars slightly.
Sauté apple quarters in butter until caramelised; serve with mash.

recipes.name: Entrecôte Marchand de Vin
recipes.description: Rib steak bathed in a rich Bordeaux wine and bone-marrow butter sauce.

steps.instruction: Season steaks and sear hard in a hot pan; rest.
Add marrow and shallots; cook until softened.
Deglaze with wine and stock; add herbs; reduce until syrupy.
Slice steak; spoon sauce over with marrow pieces.

recipes.name: Pieds et Paquets
recipes.description: Niçois specialty of stuffed tripe parcels braised in white wine with olives.

steps.instruction: Blanch tripe in boiling water 5 minutes; drain and cut into parcels, tie with string.
Sauté onions and garlic in olive oil until golden.
Brown parcels lightly; deglaze with wine; add olives and bouquet garni.
Braise covered 2.5 hours until very tender; season boldly.

recipes.name: Carbonnade Flamande
recipes.description: Flemish beer-braised beef with caramelised onions, mustard and dark bread.

steps.instruction: Brown beef cubes in batches; remove.
Caramelise onions slowly in butter 30 minutes.
Return beef; pour in beer and stock; add mustard-soaked bread.
Braise covered at 160°C for 2.5 hours until fork-tender.

recipes.name: Braise de Boeuf
recipes.description: Slow-braised beef cheeks in red wine with root vegetables and fresh herbs.

steps.instruction: Pat cheeks dry; sear hard on all sides until deeply browned.
Sauté mirepoix; add tomato paste and cook 2 minutes.
Deglaze with wine; add stock and bouquet garni.
Braise covered at 150°C for 3 hours; rest 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Rumsteck
recipes.description: Pan-seared rump steak with herb butter and haricots verts.

steps.instruction: Blanch green beans; refresh in ice water.
Sear steaks in hot oil 3 minutes per side; rest under herb butter.
Sauté shallots until golden; toss with green beans.
Slice steak; serve with vegetables and melting butter.

recipes.name: Côte de Boeuf
recipes.description: Thick bone-in rib steak roasted with thyme, garlic and sea salt.

steps.instruction: Bring steak to room temperature; season generously 30 minutes ahead.
Sear in a very hot cast-iron pan 4 minutes per side.
Add butter, garlic and thyme; baste continuously 3 minutes.
Rest 10 minutes on a warm plate; carve off the bone and slice.

recipes.name: Tournedos Rossini
recipes.description: Beef filet crowned with seared foie gras and truffle on a crouton.

steps.instruction: Sear filets in foie gras fat 2 minutes per side; rest.
Quickly sear foie gras slices until golden outside.
Toast croutons in butter; place filets on top.
Crown with foie gras, truffle shavings and Madeira sauce.

recipes.name: Andouillette
recipes.description: Grilled coarse tripe sausage from Troyes with Dijon mustard and frites.

steps.instruction: Score andouillettes; poach briefly in simmering white wine 8 minutes.
Pat dry; grill over medium-high heat until casing chars and crisps.
Fry potatoes at 150°C until soft; rest; refry at 190°C until golden.
Serve andouillettes with hot frites and generous Dijon mustard.

recipes.name: Paupiettes de Veau
recipes.description: Thin veal escalopes rolled around bacon and herbs, braised in white wine.

steps.instruction: Lay bacon on each escalope; add shallots; roll and tie with string.
Brown paupiettes on all sides in butter.
Deglaze with wine; add stock and bouquet garni.
Braise covered 1.5 hours; reduce sauce and serve over the rolls.

recipes.name: Jambonneau
recipes.description: Braised smoked ham hock served over Puy lentils with Dijon vinaigrette.

steps.instruction: Cover ham hock with cold water; bring to simmer with aromatics.
Poach gently 2 hours until meat is tender and falling off bone.
Cook lentils in strained broth with vegetables until just tender.
Slice hock; serve over lentils dressed with Dijon vinaigrette.

recipes.name: Hachis Parmentier
recipes.description: French shepherd's pie: savoury beef mince under a blanket of creamy potato mash.

steps.instruction: Sauté onions and garlic; brown ground beef; add tomato paste and stock.
Simmer until thick and rich; season well.
Boil and mash potatoes with butter and milk.
Layer meat in a dish; top with mash and cheese; bake at 200°C until golden.

recipes.name: Faux Filet Sauce Poivre
recipes.description: Sirloin steak flambéed with cognac and finished in creamy green-peppercorn sauce.

steps.instruction: Sear steaks in a very hot pan 3 minutes per side; rest.
Deglaze pan with cognac; flambé carefully.
Add stock and peppercorns; reduce by half.
Finish with cream and butter; pour over sliced steaks.

recipes.name: Coq au Vin
recipes.description: Chicken braised in red wine with lardons, mushrooms and shallots - French farmhouse grandeur.

steps.instruction: Render lardons; brown chicken in the fat; flame with brandy.
Add wine, garlic, bouquet; braise covered 45 minutes.
Sauté mushrooms and onions separately; fold in.
Reduce sauce until glossy; season boldly.

recipes.name: Poulet Basquaise
recipes.description: Basque-country chicken simmered in piperade of peppers, tomatoes and Espelette pepper.

steps.instruction: Season and brown chicken; remove.
Cook peppers and onions slowly 20 minutes; add garlic, tomato, Espelette.
Nestle chicken into piperade; simmer covered 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Poulet à la Normande
recipes.description: Cream-and-apple country: chicken braised with cider, Calvados, mushrooms and cream.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken in butter; sauté shallots and mushrooms.
Flambé with Calvados; pour in cider.
Braise covered 35 minutes; finish with cream reduced in.

recipes.name: Poulet Rôti
recipes.description: The simplest Sunday ritual: butter-basted roast chicken with lemon and thyme pan juices.

steps.instruction: Rub herbed butter all over and under skin; salt generously.
Roast at 210°C 20 minutes; reduce to 180°C for 55 more, basting.
Rest 15 minutes; make quick jus from pan juices.

recipes.name: Poulet à l'Estragon
recipes.description: Chicken braised in white wine with fresh tarragon and crème fraîche.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken pieces in butter; remove.
Sauté shallots until translucent; deglaze with wine.
Return chicken; simmer covered 30 minutes.
Stir in cream and torn tarragon; reduce to a glossy sauce.

recipes.name: Poulet Crème de Moutarde
recipes.description: Pan-fried chicken thighs in a luscious Dijon and whole-grain mustard cream.

steps.instruction: Sear chicken thighs skin-side down until golden and crisp.
Remove; sauté shallots in the same pan.
Deglaze with wine; stir in both mustards and cream.
Return chicken; simmer 25 minutes until cooked through.

recipes.name: Fricassée de Volaille
recipes.description: Creamy white stew of chicken with button mushrooms and pearl onions.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken lightly in butter; set aside.
Sauté mushrooms and onions; sprinkle flour and cook 1 minute.
Deglaze with wine; add cream and nutmeg.
Return chicken; simmer gently 25 minutes until just cooked.

recipes.name: Poulet Rôti aux Herbes
recipes.description: Whole chicken rubbed with herbes de Provence butter and roasted until golden.

steps.instruction: Rub herbed butter all over and under the chicken skin.
Stuff cavity with lemon halves and garlic.
Roast at 200°C for 1 hour, basting every 20 minutes.
Rest 10 minutes; carve and serve with pan juices.

recipes.name: Poulet Vinaigrette
recipes.description: Tender poached chicken served chilled with a sharp Dijon vinaigrette and herbs.

steps.instruction: Poach chicken breasts in gently simmering broth 15 minutes; cool completely.
Whisk Dijon, vinegar and olive oil into a sharp vinaigrette.
Slice chicken; arrange on plates with shallots and cornichons.
Spoon vinaigrette over; scatter parsley; serve chilled.

recipes.name: Poulet au Cidre
recipes.description: Normandy chicken braised in dry cider with Calvados, cream and mushrooms.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken in butter; sauté shallots and mushrooms.
Flambé with Calvados; pour in cider.
Braise covered 35 minutes until chicken is tender.
Stir in cream; reduce sauce until silky.

recipes.name: Poulet à la Moutarde
recipes.description: Chicken thighs baked in whole-grain mustard and honey cream.

steps.instruction: Season chicken thighs; sear skin-side down in an oven-safe pan.
Mix mustard, cream, honey and garlic into a sauce.
Pour sauce over chicken; scatter thyme leaves.
Bake at 180°C for 30 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.name: Coq au Vin Jaune
recipes.description: Jura classic: chicken braised in smoky vin jaune with morel mushrooms.

steps.instruction: Render lardons; brown chicken in the rendered fat.
Deglaze with vin jaune; add stock and braise covered 45 minutes.
Sauté morels and pearl onions in butter separately.
Fold into the stew with a splash of cream; reduce until glossy.

recipes.name: Poulet aux Olives
recipes.description: Provençal chicken with green olives, tomatoes and rosemary.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken legs in olive oil; remove.
Sauté garlic; add tomatoes and rosemary; cook 5 minutes.
Return chicken; pour in wine and olives.
Simmer covered 35 minutes until chicken is tender and saucy.

recipes.name: Poulet Tandoori Français
recipes.description: French-accented tandoori chicken with warming spices and crème fraîche.

steps.instruction: Score chicken; marinate in yogurt, spices, garlic, ginger and lemon 4 hours.
Roast on a rack at 220°C for 35 minutes, basting with juices.
Brush with remaining marinade halfway through.
Serve with crème fraîche and warm naan bread.

recipes.name: Poulet à la Crème
recipes.description: Chicken braised in a velvety cream sauce with button mushrooms.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken in butter; set aside.
Sauté shallots and mushrooms until golden.
Deglaze with wine; add cream and nutmeg.
Return chicken; simmer gently 30 minutes until very tender.

recipes.name: Cuisses de Poulet
recipes.description: Pan-seared chicken legs with roasted garlic and thyme jus.

steps.instruction: Season legs generously; sear skin-side down in butter until golden.
Flip; add garlic, herbs and lemon quarters.
Transfer to oven at 180°C for 25 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes; serve with pan juices spooned over.

recipes.name: Poulet Sauté Chasseur
recipes.description: Hunter's-style chicken sautéed with mushrooms, tomatoes and tarragon.

steps.instruction: Dredge chicken in seasoned flour; brown in butter.
Sauté shallots and mushrooms in the same pan.
Add tomatoes and wine; return chicken.
Simmer 25 minutes; finish with fresh tarragon.

recipes.name: Volaille de Bresse
recipes.description: AOC Bresse chicken roasted simply with butter, salt and pepper to showcase terroir.

steps.instruction: Bring chicken to room temperature; season inside and out.
Truss neatly with kitchen string.
Roast at 190°C for 1 hour 15 minutes, basting with melted butter.
Rest 15 minutes; carve and serve with pan juices.

recipes.name: Poulet à la Bière
recipes.description: Chicken braised in blonde beer with lardons, mushrooms and mustard.

steps.instruction: Render lardons; brown chicken in the fat.
Sauté onions and mushrooms in the same pan.
Return chicken; add beer and mustard.
Braise covered 40 minutes; thicken with beurre manié if needed.

recipes.name: Blanquette de Dinde
recipes.description: Turkey in a classic white cream sauce with button mushrooms and pearl onions.

steps.instruction: Poach turkey cubes with aromatics in bouillon 45 minutes; reserve liquid.
Sauté mushrooms and onions in butter.
Make velouté with flour, butter and poaching liquid.
Add cream, lemon juice and yolks off heat; fold in turkey and vegetables.

recipes.name: Ratatouille
recipes.description: Provencal summer stew of eggplant, zucchini, peppers and tomato cooked apart, married slowly.

steps.instruction: Cook each vegetable separately in olive oil; reserve.
Build an onion-tomato base with thyme and bay.
Fold vegetables through; stew gently 25 minutes uncovered.
Finish with torn basil; better the next day.

videos.videoTitle: Traditional ratatouille recipe by chef Vivien

recipes.name: Gratin Dauphinois
recipes.description: Potato slices baked in cream and garlic until unctuously tender - no cheese allowed, tradition says.

steps.instruction: Heat cream, milk, garlic and seasonings; poach potato slices 10 minutes.
Layer into a buttered dish, pressing down.
Pour over cream; bake 160°C ~75 minutes until knife-slides-easy.

recipes.name: Fritot de Tripe
recipes.description: Lightly battered and deep-fried tripe strips with garlicky aïoli.

steps.instruction: Simmer tripe in aromatics 2 hours; cool and cut into thin strips.
Dredge in seasoned flour, dip in egg wash, coat in breadcrumbs.
Deep-fry at 180°C until golden and crisp, about 3 minutes.
Drain; serve hot with garlic aïoli for dipping.

recipes.name: Soupe au Pistou
recipes.description: Provençal vegetable soup brightened with basil-pistou, the French answer to pesto.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil; add potatoes, beans and tomatoes with water.
Simmer 20 minutes; add zucchini and pasta; cook 10 minutes more.
Pound basil, garlic and olive oil into a vibrant pistou.
Swirl pistou into soup just before serving; season well.

recipes.name: Tarte à l'Oignon
recipes.description: Alsatian onion tart with crème fraîche and Gruyère on flaky pastry.

steps.instruction: Caramelize sliced onions slowly in butter with thyme 40 minutes.
Roll pastry into a tart tin; blind-bake 10 minutes.
Mix crème fraîche, eggs and cheese; fold in onions.
Pour into shell; bake at 200°C for 30 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Gratin de Courgettes
recipes.description: Zucchini baked in garlic cream with a bubbling Gruyère and Parmesan crust.

steps.instruction: Slice zucchini; layer in a buttered gratin dish.
Heat cream with garlic and nutmeg; pour over.
Top with grated Gruyère and Parmesan.
Bake at 180°C for 40 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.name: Quiche Lorraine
recipes.description: Classic egg custard tart with crisp lardons in buttery shortcrust.

steps.instruction: Line tart tin with pastry; blind-bake 10 minutes at 200°C.
Cook lardons until crisp; drain.
Whisk eggs, cream, nutmeg and seasoning; stir in lardons and cheese.
Pour into shell; bake at 180°C for 35 minutes until just set.

recipes.name: Crêpes Salées
recipes.description: Savoury buckwheat crêpes filled with melted Gruyère and topped with a fried egg.

steps.instruction: Whisk buckwheat flour, eggs and milk into a smooth batter; rest 30 minutes.
Ladle into a hot buttered pan; cook until edges crisp.
Fill with grated Gruyère; fold into triangle.
Serve hot with a fried egg on top and green salad.

recipes.name: Socca
recipes.description: Blistered chickpea-flour flatbread from Nice, perfumed with rosemary and olive oil.

steps.instruction: Whisk chickpea flour with water and 3 tbsp olive oil into a thin batter.
Rest batter at least 2 hours at room temperature.
Heat oiled cast-iron skillet until smoking; pour batter.
Broil until blistered and golden; scatter rosemary and salt.

recipes.name: Brandade Végétale
recipes.description: Whipped potato and olive-oil purée inspired by the Niçoise salt-cod classic.

steps.instruction: Boil potatoes until very tender; drain well and let steam dry.
Rice potatoes while hot; vigorously beat in olive oil and garlic.
Season with lemon juice, white pepper and a pinch of salt.
Spread in a baking dish; brown under broiler until golden crust forms.

recipes.name: Pissaladière
recipes.description: Niçoise onion flatbread studded with black olives and fragrant thyme.

steps.instruction: Caramelize onions slowly in olive oil with thyme 40 minutes.
Stretch dough into a rectangular tart on an oiled baking sheet.
Spread onions evenly; stud with olives in lines.
Bake at 220°C for 20 minutes until crust is golden and crisp.

recipes.name: Farinata
recipes.description: Crispy chickpea-flour pancake from the Riviera, seasoned with cumin and rosemary.

steps.instruction: Whisk chickpea flour with water and 2 tbsp oil; rest 4 hours.
Season with cumin and salt; preheat oven to 220°C.
Pour into hot oiled cast-iron pan.
Bake 20 minutes until crisp-edged and golden; scatter rosemary.

recipes.name: Pan Bagnat Végétarien
recipes.description: Nice-style round sandwich stuffed with marinated tomatoes, peppers, olives and basil.

steps.instruction: Dice tomatoes, peppers, onion and olives; toss with oil, vinegar and torn basil.
Split rolls; press filling generously inside.
Wrap tightly in foil and press under a heavy weight 30 minutes.
Unwrap and serve — the bread should be soaked with juices.

recipes.name: Salade Composée
recipes.description: A composed salad of greens, eggs, potatoes, green beans and Dijon vinaigrette.

steps.instruction: Cook green beans and potatoes until just tender; cool.
Arrange mixed greens on a large platter.
Top with beans, potatoes, tomatoes, olives and halved eggs.
Drizzle with Dijon vinaigrette; season and serve.

recipes.name: Céleri Rémoulade
recipes.description: Julienne of celeriac tossed in a creamy Dijon mustard dressing.

steps.instruction: Julienne celeriac finely; plunge into lemon water to prevent browning.
Pat dry thoroughly.
Whisk mustard, mayonnaise and lemon juice into dressing.
Toss celeriac with dressing; garnish with parsley; chill before serving.

recipes.name: Flamiche aux Poireaux
recipes.description: Delicate leek tart in puff pastry with cream, nutmeg and Gruyère.

steps.instruction: Sweat sliced leeks gently in butter until very soft.
Line tart tin with puff pastry.
Mix cream, eggs, cheese and nutmeg; fold in leeks.
Pour into shell; bake at 200°C for 30 minutes until golden and set.

recipes.name: Velouté de Courgettes
recipes.description: Silky zucchini soup finished with a drizzle of olive oil and fresh chives.

steps.instruction: Sweat onion and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add zucchini and stock; simmer 15 minutes until tender.
Blend until completely silky smooth.
Drizzle with olive oil; garnish with snipped chives.

recipes.name: Omelette aux Fines Herbes
recipes.description: Classic French omelette trembling with chervil, parsley, tarragon and chive.

steps.instruction: Beat eggs gently with chopped herbs and seasoning — do not over-beat.
Melt butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat until foaming.
Pour in eggs; stir gently with a fork while shaking the pan.
Fold omelette when just set but still creamy inside; serve immediately.

recipes.name: Galette de Sarrasin
recipes.description: Buckwheat crêpe filled with sautéed mushrooms and Gruyère, topped with an egg.

steps.instruction: Whisk buckwheat flour, eggs and milk into a thin batter; rest 1 hour.
Cook galette in a buttered pan until edges crisp.
Sauté mushrooms; add with Gruyère to the galette; fold into a square.
Top with a fried egg; serve immediately.

recipes.name: Brochette de Boeuf
recipes.description: Marinated beef skewers with peppers and red onion grilled over charcoal.

steps.instruction: Marinate beef cubes in herbed olive oil at least 2 hours.
Thread onto skewers alternating meat, peppers and onion.
Grill over high heat 3 minutes per side until charred outside.
Squeeze lemon over; serve with a fresh green salad.

recipes.name: Crème Brûlée
recipes.description: Cold vanilla custard beneath a shattering sheet of caramelized sugar.

steps.instruction: Infuse cream with vanilla; temper into whisked yolks and sugar.
Strain into ramekins; bake in water bath at 140°C ~35 min until just set.
Chill 4 hours minimum.
Sugar coat; torch to amber; crack dramatically.

videos.videoTitle: Recette de la crème brûlée à la vanille par HervéCuisine

recipes.name: Tarte Tatin
recipes.description: Upside-down caramelized apple tart born of accident in Lamotte-Beuvron.

steps.instruction: Cook sugar-butter into deep caramel in an oven-safe skillet.
Pack apples tightly over; top with pastry, tucking edges.
Bake 190°C ~40 minutes until pastry golden.
Rest 10 brave minutes; invert confidently; serve warm with crème fraîche.

videos.videoTitle: Tarte Tatin recette facile et simple à faire | Tarte Tatin avec la pâte brisée

recipes.name: Éclair
recipes.description: Choux pastry shell filled with vanilla crème pâtissière and glossy chocolate glaze.

steps.instruction: Cook flour, butter and water into a panade; beat in eggs one at a time.
Pipe into 12cm logs; bake at 200°C until puffed and hollow.
Make pastry cream with vanilla, milk, yolks and sugar; chill.
Fill éclairs through the base; dip tops in melted dark chocolate.

recipes.name: Paris-Brest
recipes.description: Ring of choux pastry filled with praline mousseline cream and toasted almonds.

steps.instruction: Pipe choux into a ring on parchment; sprinkle with almonds.
Bake at 190°C until deeply golden and dry inside.
Make praline mousseline cream with custard base and softened butter.
Split ring; pipe generous cream inside; replace top; dust with sugar.

recipes.name: Mille-Feuille
recipes.description: Thousand-layer puff pastry with vanilla cream and feathered chocolate fondant.

steps.instruction: Bake puff pastry sheets between trays until flat and caramelized.
Make thick vanilla crème pâtissière; chill.
Layer: pastry, cream, pastry, cream, pastry.
Ice with fondant; feather with chocolate lines; chill until set.

recipes.name: Religieuse
recipes.description: Stacked choux buns with vanilla pastry cream and cherry fondant collar.

steps.instruction: Pipe and bake large and small choux buns until hollow and golden.
Fill both with vanilla pastry cream using a piping tip.
Stack the small bun on the large; pipe a buttercream collar around the join.
Glaze both tops with cherry fondant; decorate with piped rosettes.

recipes.name: Madeleines
recipes.description: Shell-shaped lemon-scented butter cakes from Lorraine with a characteristic bump.

steps.instruction: Brown butter until nutty-smelling; cool slightly.
Whisk eggs and sugar until pale and thick; fold in flour and baking powder.
Add brown butter, lemon zest and honey; chill batter 1 hour.
Pipe into shell molds; bake at 210°C for 10 minutes then 180°C for 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Financier
recipes.description: Brown-butter almond cake with crispy golden edges and a moist centre.

steps.instruction: Brown butter until deep amber and nutty; cool.
Whisk egg whites with powdered sugar until frothy.
Fold in almond flour, flour and vanilla; add brown butter.
Pour into buttered financier molds; bake at 200°C for 12 minutes.

recipes.name: Tarte aux Fruits
recipes.description: Butter-crust tart with crème pâtissière and a mosaic of fresh seasonal fruits.

steps.instruction: Blind-bake pastry shell until golden and fully cooked.
Make crème pâtissière with vanilla, milk, yolks and sugar; chill.
Fill cooled shell with cream; arrange fresh fruits decoratively on top.
Warm apricot jam; brush over fruits for a glossy finish.

recipes.name: Fondant au Chocolat
recipes.description: Dark chocolate lava cake with a molten centre, served within minutes of baking.

steps.instruction: Melt chocolate and butter together over a bain-marie; cool slightly.
Whisk eggs and sugar until thick and pale.
Fold chocolate mixture into eggs; sift in flour and cocoa.
Pour into buttered and cocoa-dusted ramekins; bake at 220°C for exactly 10 minutes.
